answer_1.quote: In this paper, we point out that the key of Transformer length extrapolation is the better and more accurate attention score. Therefore, we develop and analyze CDAPE by processing the attention score as feature maps via convolution operation.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on language modeling where the generated outputs are next-token predictions in autoregressive language modeling tasks.

answer_2.quote: In addition to perplexity, we also leverage downstream datasets with randomized positional encoding to further assess CDAPE.
